Purpose: Preflight gate that determines whether the system is ready to enter a future execution phase. Does NOT execute capture. Only evaluates readiness for advancement.

GateResult.ExecutionPlanCompleteReason: All plan sections defined: workspace/collection templates, token budget, row count expectations, trace output path, runId policy, validation thresholds, abort conditions, rollback/cleanup procedure.
GateResult.ProductionTraceExecutionAllowedReason: Preflight does not authorize execution. ProductionTraceExecutionAllowed=false reflects that the next phase is authorization contract review, not actual execution.
GateResult.LiveCaptureExecutionImplementedReason: LiveCapture execution endpoint remains a skeleton (V16.11). Not implemented.
GateResult.NativeProductionTraceReadyReason: No native production trace has been captured. Plan phase only.

PhaseTransition.NextAllowedPhaseDescription: Define authorization contract specifics for native production trace execution (analogous to V16.8 LiveCapture authorization contract).
PhaseTransition.NextDisallowedPhaseReason: Runtime influence is permanently false. Neural bias, package mutation, and vector binding changes are structurally prohibited.
